Fixture for `TestGoldenTemae`: every dictionary row Yomitan's scanner can reach
for 「…少し手間ね」, extracted from a real Yomitan dictionary collection, and the
fields of a note Yomitan itself created for that sentence (`expected.json`).

Dictionary data: Jitendex (CC BY-SA 4.0, jitendex.org), JMnedict (EDRDG
licence), KireiCake, BCCWJ frequency list, JPDB frequency list and Kanjium
pitch accents (CC BY-SA 4.0).
